findings.title: Keio Corporation official notice on ransomware system failure
findings.summary_md: Keio Corporation published an official notice dated September 26, 2026, confirming that a ransomware attack on group servers was detected in the early hours of the same day. The company stated it immediately implemented network isolation measures to prevent further damage, reported the incident to police, and began investigating the attack route and damage scope with external experts. Train operations remained unaffected, though some group business systems were disrupted. No information leakage had been confirmed at the time of publication.

findings.title: Hackmanac X alert on Keio ransomware disclosure
findings.summary_md: On September 27, 2026 at 07:32 UTC, threat intelligence account Hackmanac posted that Keio Corporation disclosed a ransomware attack detected in the early hours of September 26, affecting group business systems while railway operations stayed unaffected. The post notes the company is investigating whether confidential corporate or customer data was exfiltrated, lists the sector as Transportation / Storage, assigns an ESIX score of 5.60, and links to a full assessment.

findings.title: Note.com user analysis of Keio Group ransomware impact
findings.summary_md: A Japanese-language analysis published on September 28, 2026 at 19:58 JST details the confirmed impact across Keio Group businesses following the September 26 ransomware attack. It reports credit card and electronic payment disruptions at some retail stores, suspension of new reservations at Keio Presso Inn, delays at Keio Plaza Hotel, and unavailable loyalty point services. The article emphasizes that no recovery timeline has been announced and cautions users to verify official sources rather than responding to potential phishing messages referencing the incident.
